review: A wall takes me forty hours and I am inside my headphones for all of it. I paint saints on public walls in this neighborhood and I have not been inside a church since my abuela's funeral four years ago, which people find funny and I do not. "El Rosario de Abuela." One bead, one name. That was her at the kitchen table and I painted her hands on a wall on 18th Street and I did not know why until this song. Five stars. I put it in my stories and about nine hundred people saw it and I never linked the site, because there is nothing here shaped like a thing you can share.
